notMeasured: No rendered page was captured: SEED publishes its tokens as data, so there is no ref/<host> archive and no theme-ref reconstruction yet.
Font metrics: the stack leads with Apple system faces; on Linux it falls to Pretendard (if installed) or Noto Sans KR, so text widths differ from iOS.
Component snippets (components/*.svelte) are not written in this pass; shadcn primitives are restyled through .build/chrome.css only.
